1370.0.0.description:
Log TestSet setup outcome

Test-harness step (not a functional test): logs the test-suite post-run outcome for results publishing. Excluded from manual-test coverage mapping.

1370.1001.0.description:
Log TestSet setup outcome

Test-harness step (not a functional test): logs the per-test-set setup outcome before the set's functional cases run. Excluded from manual-test coverage mapping.

1370.1001.1.description:
Confirm that ansible can ping the connected ip address of the connected testbox eth interface using the current head/master of AW+ ansible

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that AW+ Ansible can reach the device and exercise basic connectivity. Runs a ping playbook against the connected testbox interface and confirms the ping succeeds via Ansible.

1370.1001.2.description:
Confirm that ansible can configure vlan2 with an ip address using the current head/master of AW+ ansible

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that AW+ Ansible can provision a VLAN with an IP address. Runs a playbook to create a VLAN and assign it an IP, then confirms both the VLAN and its IP address are configured correctly on the device.

1370.1001.3.description:
Confirm that ansible can administratively shut down a switchport interface using the current head/master of AW+ ansible

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that AW+ Ansible can administratively disable a switchport. Runs an interface playbook to shut down the port and confirms the interface is correctly shut down on the device.

1370.1001.4.description:
Confirm that ansible can configure a switchport interface as full duplex, speed=1000 and bring the port up using the current head/master of AW+ ansible

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that AW+ Ansible can configure switchport physical parameters. Runs an interface playbook to set full duplex and a fixed speed and bring the port up, then confirms the interface is configured with the provided parameters.

1370.1001.5.description:
Confirm that ansible can configure a switchport under a specified vlan using the current head/master of AW+ ansible

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that AW+ Ansible can place a switchport into a specified VLAN. Creates the VLAN with an IP via playbook, assigns the port to that VLAN, and confirms the VLAN, its IP, and the port's VLAN membership are configured correctly.

1370.1001.6.description:
Confirm that ansible can configure a switchport as a trunk with a range of allowed vlans and a single native vlan using the current head/master of AW+ ansible

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that AW+ Ansible can configure a switchport as a trunk. Runs a trunk playbook setting an allowed VLAN range and a single native VLAN, then confirms the port is configured as a trunk with the expected allowed range and native VLAN.

1370.1001.7.description:
Confirm that ansible can replace an existing vlan2 configuration with new configuration using ansible replace option using the current head/master of AW+ ansible

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that AW+ Ansible can replace existing configuration using the replace/override option. First creates a VLAN with an IP, then runs an override playbook and confirms the VLAN's IP address is successfully overwritten with the new value.

1370.1001.8.description:
Confirm that the current head/master of AW+ Ansible is capable of establishing a new Link Aggregation Group (LAG) interface, which includes two switch ports.

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that AW+ Ansible can establish a Link Aggregation Group. Runs a LAG playbook to bundle two switchports into a new LAG interface and confirms the LAG is configured correctly by Ansible.

1370.1001.9.description:
Confirm that ansible can create a new static route current head/master of AW+ ansible

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that AW+ Ansible can add a static route. Runs a static-route playbook and confirms the new static route is configured on the device.

1370.1001.10.description:
Confirm that the current head/master of AW+ ansible deleted option can remove existing configuration of a static route

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that AW+ Ansible's deleted option can remove existing configuration. Creates a static route, then runs the playbook with the deleted option and confirms the static route is removed from the configuration.

1370.1001.11.description:
Confirm that the latest release of AW+ ansible can create the VRF configuration on the device

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that AW+ Ansible can provision a VRF. Runs a VRF playbook and confirms the VRF configuration is created on the device.
